leadText:
Mimi (Japanese: マオ Mao) is a character of the day who appeared in Where Did You Go, Audino?.

Officer Jenny asked and Christie to watch after Mimi's after many other Audino began to disappear in the town. Mimi was concerned that her Audino would be the next to disappear. However, Christie and Iris assured her that they had everything under control and put a tracking device on her Audino. Her worst fears came true when Audino began to act strangely and left her side.

After the case was solved, it is assumed that Mimi got her Audino back safe and sound.
